hints.text: The symbol $\leq$ means "less than or equal to". Which choices are no bigger than $3$?
Compare each choice with $3$. The numbers $5$, $4$ and $7$ are all greater, so check the remaining one.
$3 \leq 3$ is true because of the "or equal to" part, so the solution is $3$, choice C.

explanation: $x \leq 3$ is true for $3$ and for every number smaller than $3$.
The choices $5$, $4$ and $7$ are all greater than $3$, so they fail.
The choice $3$ works because $3 \leq 3$ allows the two sides to be equal.
The only solution listed is $3$, which is choice C.
